resources.string: Map tiles need a valid Maps API key. Configure secrets.properties and rebuild.
Google Play services is missing or needs an update. The map and local location are unavailable.
Enable foreground location to show your position. Approximate location is supported. Your location is not shared with friends.
Device location is off. Turn it on to show your position.
Live location updates are temporarily unavailable.
Trailo map. Pan and zoom to explore.
Local emulator session. Location is not shared.
Request completed. Current membership is shown below.
Anyone with this invitation can join. Generating a new one revokes older invitations.
End this convoy for everyone and revoke all invitations?
Waiting for the local emulators. Cached membership is hidden. A timed-out request may have completed; refresh before trying again.
Invitation is invalid, expired, revoked, or its convoy has ended.
Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
You already belong to an active convoy. Refresh your session.
Check the convoy name or invitation format. Names must contain 1–80 visible characters.
This session is no longer available or your membership was revoked.
Unable to confirm your anonymous identity. Refresh to reconnect.
Convoy access is disabled in this build.
The request could not be confirmed. Refresh your session before retrying.
The request timed out or its response was lost. Its outcome is unknown. Checking your session before allowing another action.
Waiting for the server to confirm the request…
Your current session has been checked with the server. The earlier request was not automatically repeated.
The earlier request is still unresolved. You can return to the map or check again when connected. Further convoy actions are paused to avoid conflicting requests.
The server cancelled the request before it committed. Your current session has been refreshed; you may try again.
The create request committed. Showing your current session.
The join request committed. Showing your current membership.
The leave request committed. Showing your current session.
The end request committed. Showing your current session.
The invitation was created, but its secret cannot be recovered. Generate a replacement invitation to revoke it.
